description: This file contains Go source code for testing the Android CIBuildAPI, including functions for downloading artifacts, generating signed URLs, and handling HTTP requests with mock clients. It defines test functions, mock HTTP clients, and utility functions for testing build artifact download processes.

methods.name: TestDownloadArtifact
methods.description: Test for downloading a build artifact successfully, verifying content correctness.

methods.name: TestDownloadArtifactWithErrorResponse
methods.description: Test for error handling when the artifact download returns an error response.

methods.name: TestBuildDownloadArtifactSignedURL
methods.description: Test for generating signed URLs for artifact download, including URL escaping.

methods.name: TestCredentialsAddedToRequest
methods.description: Test to verify that credentials are correctly added to HTTP requests.

methods.name: TestEmptyCredentialsIgnored
methods.description: Test to ensure empty credentials do not add Authorization headers.
